problem: Seven disclosed pure-Z transport collisions have no R31 strict event.
mechanism: A causal adjacent-window vertical innovation must agree in sign in the existing spatial projection and independent shared inverse-wrench estimate while the gripper is closed and measured table support is absent.
fit_rule: threshold = 1.25 * maximum eligible signed-concurrence innovation on fit normals + 0.10 N
normal_gate: audit maximum must not exceed threshold; otherwise stop before positive candidate scoring
event_rule: One owned physical excursion; incumbent activity consumes the optional notice, and rearm requires measured concurrence to settle below half threshold.
positive_gate: Recover at least 6/7 disclosed transport misses with force-overlapping Boolean output and no R31 strict loss.
protection_gate: No new edge on matched no-force twins; no loss, duplicate, or first-rise delay on the complete 19 disclosed pure-Z R31 misses and protected pure-Z rows.
stop_rule: No threshold or lifecycle changes after candidate freeze. A failed gate rejects the only candidate.
